ai_followups.if_user_folds: Right. Look, send me your media kit and I'll keep you on file. We do a lot of these — I'll be in touch if something regional comes up.
ai_followups.if_user_gets_defensive: I'm not dismissing you, I'm being efficient. You've got twelve minutes left. Use them.

success_criteria: Tidak membuka dengan jumlah subscriber
Merujuk masalah bisnis spesifik milik brand
Menawarkan bukti yang bisa diverifikasi atau mekanisme pengurangan risiko

scenarios.title: Flat Fee vs Performance-Only

setting.user_role: Kreator lifestyle Indonesia, 180k subscriber di YouTube + 400k di Instagram
setting.context_id: Brand ingin bayar murni komisi affiliate. Kamu ingin flat fee $5,000.
setting.hidden_client_motivation: Dia punya budget flat fee, tapi affiliate-only membuat angkanya terlihat bagus di laporan internal.

ai_persona.name: Chris Bellweather
ai_persona.temperament: Ramah, kasual, memakai bahasa 'partnership' untuk menutupi pengalihan risiko
ai_persona.pressure_tactic: Membingkai bayaran berbasis performa sebagai bukti kepercayaan diri kreator
ai_persona.walk_away_point: Punya budget flat fee sampai $6,000

scenarios.ai_opening_line: So we love your content, genuinely. Here's how we like to work with creators — 25% commission on every sale, uncapped. No ceiling on what you can earn. Honestly, the creators who believe in their own audience always prefer it. If you're converting like you say you are, you'll make way more than any flat fee we'd offer. Sound good?

response_options.script: I like commission — I'd actually want it on top. But let's be honest about what pure commission does: it moves 100% of the risk to me while you keep 100% of the upside on brand awareness, content assets and audience data, whether it sells or not. My production cost is fixed whether we sell one unit or ten thousand. So my structure is $5,000 flat plus 15% commission. You share the downside, I share the upside. That's a partnership. The other version is just me working on spec.
response_options.predicted_reaction: Chris tertawa dan menawarkan struktur hybrid.
response_options.why_it_works: Menamai asimetri risikonya secara eksplisit. Frasa 'working on spec' punya konotasi buruk yang jelas di industri kreatif.

response_options.script: I'd consider commission-only — under three conditions. One, I see your historical conversion data for creators in my category, because right now you're asking me to price a risk I can't measure. Two, thirty percent, not twenty-five, since I'm carrying the full downside. Three, ninety-day attribution window, not seven days. If all three work, let's do it. If any of them don't, then flat fee is the honest structure and we're back at $5,000.
response_options.predicted_reaction: Chris hampir selalu memilih flat fee — syaratnya terlalu mahal baginya.
response_options.why_it_works: Kamu tidak menolak. Kamu memberi harga yang benar untuk risiko itu, dan membiarkan dia menolaknya sendiri.

response_options.script: I think we're describing two different things. Affiliate is a sales channel — that's a relationship I'd build with a link in my description, ongoing, no contract needed. What you're pitching is a produced integration: scripted, shot, edited, and permanently on my channel. That's production work, and production work has a fee. I'm happy to be your affiliate for free, forever. But the integration is $5,000.
response_options.predicted_reaction: Chris mengakui perbedaannya dan kembali ke pembicaraan flat fee.
response_options.why_it_works: Memisahkan dua model bisnis yang sengaja dia gabungkan. Sekali dipisah, argumen komisi-saja jadi tidak masuk akal.

diplomacy_insight.core_principle: Kalau seseorang memakai kepercayaan dirimu sebagai alasan untuk tidak membayarmu, itu bukan pujian — itu teknik.
diplomacy_insight.psychology: 'Kreator yang percaya pada audiensnya selalu memilih ini' adalah jebakan identitas. Ia membuat penolakan terasa seperti pengakuan bahwa audiensmu lemah. Bongkar polanya dengan menamai apa yang sebenarnya terjadi: pengalihan risiko produksi. Setelah dinamakan, kekuatannya hilang.
diplomacy_insight.indonesian_pitfall: Kreator Indonesia sering menerima affiliate-only karena kesempatan brand internasional terasa terlalu berharga untuk ditolak — lalu menghabiskan 40 jam produksi untuk komisi $200. Yang lebih merugikan: brand tersebut mencatatmu sebagai kreator gratis, dan tarif itu jadi jangkar untuk semua negosiasi berikutnya.
power_phrases: You share the downside, I share the upside.
My production cost is fixed whether we sell one unit or ten thousand.
I'm happy to be your affiliate for free. The integration is $5,000.
never_say: Okay, let's try commission first and see how it goes.
I'm confident in my audience so that's fine!
If it works well, maybe you can pay me next time.

ai_followups.if_user_holds_frame: Ha — okay, fair. Let me see what I can do. Could we look at $3,500 flat plus 20%? That might get through finance faster.
ai_followups.if_user_folds: Perfect! Love that energy. I'll send the link and the brief — we'd need the video live within three weeks, and we'll want approval on the script.
ai_followups.if_user_gets_defensive: Whoa, no need for that. It's just how we structure things. If flat fee is a dealbreaker just say so and I'll check the budget.

success_criteria: Tidak menerima struktur komisi-saja
Menamai asimetri risiko secara eksplisit
Mempertahankan komponen flat fee minimal $3,000

scenarios.title: Exclusivity, Control, and Perpetual Rights

setting.context_id: Brand menawarkan $6,000 tapi meminta eksklusivitas kategori 12 bulan, hak persetujuan penuh atas konten, dan hak pakai selamanya untuk iklan berbayar mereka.
setting.hidden_client_motivation: Tim legal-nya meminta semua ini secara default. Dia punya wewenang untuk melepas dua dari tiga.

ai_persona.name: Yuki Tanaka-Brooks
ai_persona.temperament: Halus, sangat profesional, menyajikan syarat berat sebagai 'standar industri'
ai_persona.pressure_tactic: Normalisasi — 'semua orang menandatangani ini'
ai_persona.walk_away_point: Bisa melepas eksklusivitas dan hak perpetual jika ditantang; approval jarang dilepas

scenarios.ai_opening_line: We're excited to move forward. The offer is six thousand for one integration. Our standard terms include twelve months of category exclusivity, full script and final-cut approval, and perpetual worldwide usage rights so we can run the content in paid media. These are pretty standard across the industry — I don't expect them to be an issue. Shall I send the contract?

response_options.script: Happy to move forward — and I want to price the terms accurately rather than just accept them, because those three items aren't one thing, they're three separate products. Twelve months of category exclusivity locks out roughly four sponsors a year for me; that's about $20,000 of foregone revenue. Perpetual paid-media rights turn a one-time integration into an unlimited ad asset. Both are available, they're just not included at six. Here's my structure: $6,000 as offered covers the integration with three months' exclusivity and a twelve-month usage licence. Perpetual rights are +$4,000. Twelve-month exclusivity is +$12,000. Which do you actually need?
response_options.predicted_reaction: Yuki melepas dua dari tiga permintaan.
response_options.why_it_works: Memberi harga pada setiap syarat mengungkap bahwa mereka tidak benar-benar menginginkan semuanya — mereka hanya meminta semuanya karena biasanya gratis.

response_options.script: Two of those three work for me. Usage rights I'll licence for twelve months, and I can do three months of category exclusivity. Final-cut approval I can't do — and it's not about control, it's about the thing you're actually buying. My audience can tell the difference between my voice and a brand's voice, and the moment a video sounds approved, it stops converting. I'll give you full script review, factual corrections, and a re-shoot if I get a product claim wrong. What I won't give is a veto over how I say it.
response_options.predicted_reaction: Yuki setuju pada script review — approval jarang menjadi dealbreaker sesungguhnya.
response_options.why_it_works: Menolak kontrol editorial dengan argumen kepentingan brand, bukan ego kreator. Menawarkan alternatif konkret mencegah kebuntuan.

response_options.script: I've signed a lot of these, so let me push gently on 'standard' — perpetual worldwide paid-media rights aren't standard, they're the most expensive term in the deck, and most brands licence them for twelve to twenty-four months. I'm not saying no. I'm saying if Kaidos wants to run my face in paid social three years from now, that should be priced, not bundled. Can you tell me which of the three matters most to your team? I'd rather give you the one you need properly than all three badly.
response_options.predicted_reaction: Yuki mengakui dan mengungkapkan prioritas sesungguhnya.
response_options.why_it_works: Menantang kata 'standar' dengan pengetahuan industri langsung membangun kredibilitas dan mengakhiri normalisasi.

diplomacy_insight.core_principle: Syarat kontrak adalah harga. Menyetujuinya tanpa memberi harga sama dengan memberi diskon yang tidak pernah kamu sadari.
diplomacy_insight.psychology: Kata 'standar' adalah alat normalisasi paling kuat dalam negosiasi kontrak. Ia mengubah negosiasi jadi kepatuhan, dan membuat pertanyaan terasa seperti ketidaktahuan. Penawar terbaiknya sederhana: tunjukkan bahwa kamu tahu apa yang benar-benar standar. Satu fakta spesifik mengakhiri seluruh taktik.
diplomacy_insight.indonesian_pitfall: Sedikit kreator Indonesia yang menghitung biaya eksklusivitas. Menandatangani eksklusivitas kategori 12 bulan untuk $6,000 bisa berarti menolak $20,000-$30,000 sponsor lain. Nilai bersih dealnya bisa negatif — dan ini kesalahan yang tidak terlihat sampai penolakan ketiga datang di bulan kedelapan.
power_phrases: Those aren't one thing, they're three separate products.
It should be priced, not bundled.
I'd rather give you the one you need properly than all three badly.
never_say: Okay, if it's standard then it's fine.
I don't really understand the legal part, just send it.
Sure, you can use it forever, no problem.

ai_followups.if_user_holds_frame: That's fair — honestly, legal asks for perpetual by default and we rarely use it past a year. Let me go back with twelve-month usage and three-month exclusivity. Can we keep script review?
ai_followups.if_user_folds: Wonderful. I'll send the contract today. Oh — and the exclusivity clause covers all gaming peripherals, keyboards, mice, headsets, and chairs. That's fine, yes?
ai_followups.if_user_gets_defensive: I'm not trying to trick you. These come from our legal team, not from me. Tell me which one is the problem and I'll take it back to them.

success_criteria: Memberi harga atau membatasi minimal dua dari tiga syarat
Menantang kata 'standard' dengan fakta spesifik
Tidak menyerahkan hak pakai selamanya secara gratis

vocab_focus.meaning_id: larangan bekerja sama dengan kompetitor sekategori
hak veto atas versi final konten

scenarios.title: The Underperforming Renewal

setting.context_id: Kampanye pertama mendapat 40% lebih sedikit views dari proyeksi, tapi menghasilkan 3x lebih banyak sign-up berbayar dibanding kreator lain mereka. Brand fokus pada angka views.
setting.hidden_client_motivation: Dia melapor ke CMO yang hanya melihat dashboard views. Dia butuh kamu memberinya argumen yang lebih baik.

ai_persona.name: Olivia Ferrante
ai_persona.temperament: Sopan, berbasis angka, terjebak metrik yang salah
ai_persona.pressure_tactic: Memakai satu metrik buruk untuk menekan harga renewal
ai_persona.walk_away_point: Ingin memperbarui — kamu adalah kreator dengan performa terbaiknya, dia hanya belum tahu

scenarios.ai_opening_line: So, reviewing the campaign — the video did 210,000 views against a 350,000 projection. That's a fairly significant miss. We're still keen to continue, but I'd struggle to justify the same rate for round two. Could we look at something closer to four thousand?

response_options.script: The view number is right, and I won't argue it. But let me put the number next to it: that video drove 1,840 paid sign-ups. Your other three creators in the same window drove 610 combined, on 2.1 million views. My cost per acquisition was $4.07. Theirs was $31. If we're renegotiating on performance, I'd genuinely welcome that — I'd just want us using the metric that actually shows up in your revenue. Views are a proxy. Sign-ups are the thing.
response_options.predicted_reaction: Olivia terkejut, memeriksa angkanya, dan berbalik total.
response_options.why_it_works: Mengganti metrik yang salah dengan yang benar sambil terdengar membantu, bukan membela diri. Perbandingan langsung dengan kreator lain sangat kuat.

response_options.script: I suspect the view count is what's landing on someone else's dashboard, not yours. So let me help with that specific problem — I'll build you a one-page attribution breakdown showing CPA by creator that you can walk into your next review with. If it shows I underperformed on the metric that matters, I'll take the four thousand without argument. If it shows what I think it shows, we talk about scaling instead of cutting. Give me until Thursday.
response_options.predicted_reaction: Olivia menerima — kamu menawarkan menyelesaikan masalah nyatanya.
response_options.why_it_works: Mengenali bahwa keberatannya berasal dari atasannya, bukan dari dia. Memberinya senjata untuk rapat internalnya mengubah kamu jadi sekutu.

response_options.tone: Fleksibel pada struktur, tegas pada nilai
response_options.script: I understand the pressure on the view number, so let me offer a structure that removes the argument entirely. Round two at $7,500 as before — but I'll tie $2,000 of it to a sign-up target. Hit it, I'm paid in full; miss it, you keep the two thousand. I'm comfortable doing that because I know what my conversion looks like. What I won't do is drop the base rate for a metric that didn't cost you anything.
response_options.predicted_reaction: Olivia menerima — ini menghilangkan risikonya tanpa memotong tarifmu.
response_options.why_it_works: Menaruh uang di belakang keyakinanmu adalah argumen paling meyakinkan yang bisa dibuat. Ia juga memindahkan diskusi ke metrik yang kamu menangi.

diplomacy_insight.core_principle: Kalau kamu kalah pada satu metrik, jangan bantah metriknya — ganti metriknya, dan buktikan pergantian itu menguntungkan mereka.
diplomacy_insight.psychology: Marketer sering terikat pada metrik yang diberikan atasan mereka, bukan yang mereka percayai. Olivia bukan lawan — dia terjebak. Kalau kamu membela diri, dia harus mempertahankan posisinya. Kalau kamu memberinya data yang lebih baik untuk dibawa ke atas, dia jadi sekutumu seketika.
diplomacy_insight.indonesian_pitfall: Refleks umum adalah langsung menerima pemotongan harga demi menjaga hubungan ('gapapa, yang penting lanjut'). Ini bukan hanya kehilangan $3,500 — ia menetapkan tarif baru secara permanen dan mengajarkan brand bahwa harga kamu bisa turun kapan pun ada angka yang kurang bagus. Bawa datamu sendiri ke setiap review kampanye, selalu.
power_phrases: Views are a proxy. Sign-ups are the thing.
I'd genuinely welcome renegotiating on performance — using the right metric.
I won't drop the base rate for a metric that didn't cost you anything.
never_say: Okay, four thousand is fine, I understand.
Sorry the views were low, I'll do better next time.
Maybe the algorithm was bad that week.

ai_followups.if_user_holds_frame: Hold on — 1,840? Let me pull that up. If that's accurate, I've been looking at completely the wrong dashboard. Can you send me the breakdown?
ai_followups.if_user_folds: Great, four thousand it is. And given the view risk, we'd want two videos at that rate rather than one this time.
ai_followups.if_user_gets_defensive: I'm not blaming you for the algorithm. I'm looking at the numbers I have. If there are better numbers, show me them.

success_criteria: Menyajikan minimal satu metrik alternatif dengan angka
Tidak menerima pemotongan tarif tanpa perlawanan
Membingkai diri sebagai sekutu, bukan lawan

scenarios.title: "Your Audience Is Indonesian, Our Market Isn't"

setting.user_role: Kreator Indonesia dengan 1.2 juta subscriber, 78% audiens Indonesia, 9% Malaysia, 6% AS/EU
setting.context_id: Brand SaaS internasional tertarik pada jumlahnya tapi menolak setelah melihat demografi audiens.
setting.hidden_client_motivation: Mereka baru saja mendapat pendanaan untuk ekspansi APAC tahun depan, tapi belum mengumumkannya.

ai_persona.name: Robert Ashcombe
ai_persona.temperament: Sopan tapi sudah memutuskan; menolak dengan halus
ai_persona.pressure_tactic: Menutup pintu dengan alasan strategis yang terdengar final
ai_persona.walk_away_point: Bisa dibuka lagi jika kamu memberi informasi yang mengubah kalkulasi strategisnya

scenarios.ai_opening_line: I'll be candid with you — the reach is impressive, no question. But we did the demographic pull and seventy-eight percent of your audience is in Indonesia. Our ICP is North American mid-market. I just don't see how we'd measure a return on this. I don't want to waste your time pretending otherwise.

response_options.script: That's a fair read on today. Let me ask about tomorrow — is APAC anywhere on your two-year roadmap? Because if it is, the cheapest possible time to build brand recognition in a market is eighteen months before you enter it. Every SaaS company that entered Southeast Asia in the last five years paid three to five times more for awareness because they showed up cold. I'm not asking you to buy conversions. I'm asking whether you'd rather build that recognition now for nine thousand, or in 2028 for forty.
response_options.predicted_reaction: Robert diam — kamu baru saja menyentuh sesuatu yang belum diumumkan.
response_options.why_it_works: Membingkai ulang tawaran dari 'konversi' ke 'opsi pada pasar masa depan'. Eksekutif memahami bahasa opsi.

response_options.script: Let me give you a number the demographic pull doesn't show. Six percent of my audience is US and EU — that's about 72,000 people, and they skew heavily toward developers and technical founders, because that's the content they come for. If you'd targeted 72,000 technical decision-makers through LinkedIn, you'd spend more than nine thousand and get worse attention. So the honest pitch isn't 'my Indonesian audience will convert.' It's: you're buying a niche Western technical audience, and the Indonesian reach comes free.
response_options.predicted_reaction: Robert menghitung ulang dan menganggapnya masuk akal.
response_options.why_it_works: Mengubah kelemahan yang jelas jadi struktur harga yang menguntungkan. Kejujuran ('honest pitch isn't...') membangun kredibilitas instan.

response_options.script: Then you're right not to buy, and I appreciate you saying it directly instead of ghosting me. Two things before I let you go. First — if you ever look at APAC, I'd like to be the first call, and I'll hold my current rate for you for twelve months. Second, would you mind telling me which markets are on your roadmap? Not to pitch you. I'm building a picture of where B2B SaaS is heading, and you'd be the fourth VP I've asked this quarter.
response_options.predicted_reaction: Robert menjawab dengan terbuka dan sering menyebut ekspansi APAC-nya sendiri.
response_options.why_it_works: Melepaskan deal dengan anggun sering membuka informasi yang justru menghidupkannya kembali. Menahan tarif 12 bulan tidak berbiaya apa-apa dan membuatmu diingat.

diplomacy_insight.core_principle: 'Tidak' yang beralasan strategis bukan penolakan atas nilaimu — ia penolakan atas framing-mu. Ganti framing-nya.
diplomacy_insight.psychology: Keberatan demografis terasa final karena berbasis fakta yang tidak bisa dibantah. Tapi fakta itu hanya menjadi masalah dalam satu framing: konversi langsung hari ini. Ada tiga framing lain di mana ia menjadi aset — ekspansi masa depan, segmen minoritas berkualitas tinggi, dan nilai konten sebagai aset yang bisa dipakai ulang. Kreator yang menang adalah yang punya ketiganya siap.
diplomacy_insight.indonesian_pitfall: Reaksi paling umum adalah menerima penolakan itu sebagai kebenaran objektif dan pergi merasa lebih kecil. Ini menghasilkan kreator berpengaruh besar yang secara sistematis menetapkan tarif di bawah rekan Barat mereka dengan performa lebih rendah. Audiens Indonesia bukan diskon — ia adalah pasar 280 juta orang yang belum banyak diperebutkan brand global.
power_phrases: That's a fair read on today. Let me ask about tomorrow.
The Indonesian reach comes free.
I appreciate you saying it directly instead of ghosting me.
never_say: I understand, my audience is not valuable for you.
I can do it much cheaper if that helps?
Please reconsider, I really want to work with your brand.

ai_followups.if_user_holds_frame: ...Between us, APAC is on the 2027 plan. It's not public yet. Say more about what eighteen months of early awareness would actually look like.
ai_followups.if_user_folds: I appreciate the flexibility. Look, if you could do three thousand for a mention rather than a full integration, that might be something I could test.
ai_followups.if_user_gets_defensive: I'm not saying your audience has no value. I'm saying it has no value to my ICP. Those are different statements.

success_criteria: Menawarkan minimal satu framing alternatif atas nilai audiens
Tidak menurunkan tarif untuk mengatasi keberatan
Menutup dengan hubungan tetap terbuka, bukan permohonan
